data.name: Azim
data.long_meaning: Azim is a powerful and reverent name of Arabic origin, meaning 'great', 'magnificent', or 'mighty'. It is derived from one of the beautiful names of Allah: Al-Azeem (The Most Great). Azim signifies honor, strength, and reverence.

It is derived from the Arabic root 'A-Z-M', which means 'to be great', 'to be magnificent', or 'to be glorious'. In Islamic tradition, Azim is considered a name that reflects the qualities of Allah, such as His grandeur, majesty, and glory. It is also associated with the concept of 'izzat', or dignity, which is considered a fundamental aspect of a person's character. In modern times, Azim has become a popular name across various cultures, symbolizing strength, courage, and nobility.
